title: Welcome Kuaizi Technology (筷子科技) as a Unique Partner
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Unique Partner · May 8, 2024

Unique Partner Network (UPN) introduction:

About Kuaizi

Founded 2013 — tech provider for the global content-commerce ecosystem. Enterprise AIGC content-commerce SaaS. Selected awards: Facebook/Instagram Greater China first globally certified creative-tech partner (2017); Alimama Intelligent Creative awards; Google I/O China preferred creative-tech for app promotion (2019); Ocean Engine official intelligent creative partner (2021); Baidu marketing creative/content (2021); ECI Awards Martech gold+silver / Index Top 10; Jiazi “Star 20” 2023 AI application innovators; Tmall DIGITAL AIGC excellent vendor; Cyzone 2023 most-watchable AIGC company.

Platform

Kuaizi = tuned vertical models + full-modal datasets + native apps on proprietary content-structure engine FusionX.

Full chain: only claimed tool spanning script→shoot→edit→buy→manage; 10–50× video output speed/volume; AI scripts; smart edit; one-tap multi-channel distribute; standardized content teams.

AIGC apps: AI script, deconstructor, one-tap film, voiceover, product image, digital human… Vertical models: BV-1 brand visual deconstruction; KV-1 key-visual gen; VS-1 short-video voiceover copy; Nara.ai multimodal fine-tune with director logic for commerce short video. CAC algorithms filed (one-tap film + text-gen IDs in CN).

Custom dev + open AI one-tap film API for batch commercial video. Claims strong PMF vs peers still exploring — subscription-led scaled revenue in B2B commercial video.

Cases

MINISO: 5,000+ stores globally / 3,000+ in China — content marketing mid-platform + matrix accounts (“美好生活体验官”); +600% exposure; +200M+ monthly new exposure; stores as digital assets.

Herun (和润): health ads — structured script+asset fission; content efficiency 10×+; revenue +400%; ROI +5,000+.

Partner imagery — attach on ingest (6 images).

— END —
